verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's own marketing claims it turns handwriting and checkboxes into clean markdown. Its enriched forms pass returns form fields with values, checkbox states and bounding boxes, which covers recognizing and extracting handwritten fields. Nothing in the evidence shows confidence scores or uncertainty flags on extracted handwriting, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of handwriting accuracy. Missing for 10: per-field confidence or uncertainty flagging, explicit annotation/margin-note extraction, detailed handwriting docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, handwritten fields and annotations are recognized and extracted, flagged with confidence when uncertain

citations.quote: Turn even the most complex layouts, tables, charts, handwriting, checkboxes, and images into clean markdown
Turn on the enriched forms pass to get each form page as structured JSON — fields with values, checkbox states, and bounding boxes
